doc.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008

title: The Depression years
summary: The family simply adjusted to the Depression.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now you mentioned, in the middle of the depression — at the time of the depression were you aware that this is a depression? I mean some people say that while you’re living through it, for some people it wasn’t that much different. But was it a particularly hard time for your family and for you?

At the time no, we didn’t — it was just something that we adjusted to. It’s just something that we realized well this is the case and this is what we will — we’ll adjust to what we have to do. No it wasn’t.
